in_sanskrit.name: Muniraju
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A combination of the words 'Muni' (wise man, sage, philosopher) and 'Raju' (king, ruler).

in_hindi.name: Muniraju
in_hindi.long_meaning: A wise king or a ruling sage in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: முனிராஜு
in_tamil.long_meaning: A wise king or a ruling sage in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: మునిరాజు
in_telugu.long_meaning: A wise king or a ruling sage in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Muniraju
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muniraju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muniraju is a name of Lord Rama, derived from the Sanskrit words 'muni' meaning sage and 'raja' meaning king. It signifies a wise and powerful ruler.

in_bengali.name: Muniraju
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Mountain
in_bengali.long_meaning: Muniraju একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Muniraju is a name of Lord Rama, derived from the Sanskrit words 'muni' meaning sage and 'raja' meaning king. It signifies a wise and powerful ruler.
